# Guidelines for Writing Documents the Assistant Can Use
1. One topic per file, with a clear title.
2. Use short headings (##) for each sub-topic.
3. Write full sentences with the key term in them (say "Backups run every night", not "Nightly").
4. Put facts, such as numbers and limits, in the same paragraph as the topic.
5. Name the plan or product version the fact applies to.
6. Keep files in the data/ folder as .md.
7. After adding or editing files, run: python src\ingest.py
